chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: Don Voorhees, the Rain or Shine show and radio work in 1928
summary: After the New Yorkers he joined Don Voorhees, playing the Broadway show Rain or Shine and NBC radio, and also worked with Sam Lanin.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: When? ....After the New Yorker group broke up, then you joined Don Vorhees?
What kind - what did he have? Did he have a band or what?
Yeah, radio it was. It was down here, somewhere between here and here.
Okay, do you remember my notes? Who else was playing with you? Do you remember that?
Was playing with Don Vorhees and you. You don't remember? Okay. You were playing for his show on
Rain or shine, Joe Cook was the star of the show.
And at the same time, this is 1928, the same time Vorhees was doing radio shows and you were doing those with him.
NBC I think, yeah. And also you were doing shows with Sam Lanin.
You were very busy in those days.
